translated_title: Mexico Unveils Prototype of Domestic Electric Minivehicle 'Olinia'
original_title: Presentan prototipo de auto eléctrico mexicano
author: Arturo Sánchez Jiménez and Alma E. Muñoz
meta_description: Mexico's federal government unveiled the Olinia, a domestic electric minivehicle that charges in a household outlet, with production set for 2027 — part of Plan México to build a national auto brand.
